# Fixture Index

Every implemented rule should have a `tests/fixtures/<slug>-all-scenarios.html` scenario page (numbered `case_NN` blocks, each marked PASS/FAIL/CANTTELL in its `.case-title`) and a "fixture coverage" test in its `tests/engine-checks/**/<rule>.test.js` asserting the exact expected ids. A profile's rules keep both in the profile, under `profiles/<name>/tests/fixtures/` and `profiles/<name>/tests/rules/`. See `docs/RULE_AUTHORING.md`.
